zh.title: 芬蘭瑞典首次參與澳洲PitchBlack演習印度Rafale首秀
zh.summary: 芬蘭與瑞典首次派官方代表團參加澳洲Pitch Black 26演習，觀摩多國空軍作戰；印度空軍Rafale戰機亦首次參與該演習，測試遠距作戰能力並加強與夥伴國的合作。
body: 芬蘭與瑞典於2026年8月6日發佈的AeroTime報導指出，兩國首次派遣官方代表團前往皇家澳洲空軍（RAAF）達爾文基地，觀摩Exercise Pitch Black 26。此次標誌著芬蘭與瑞典北歐國家首次參與澳洲旗艦多國空軍對抗演習。
代表團於7月20日至8月7日期間在北澳洲地區進行觀摩，重點在於了解澳洲如何在大規模多國環境中協調第四代與第五代戰鬥機，以及指揮與控制系統的整合。芬蘭空軍作戰中心上校Ville Uggeldahl表示，該團隊特別關注澳洲的指揮管制與快速噴射機平台整合經驗。
瑞典代表團則聚焦於快速噴射機在高強度演習中的維護與後勤支援。瑞典空軍飛機技師Master Sergeant Ronny Hagman指出，他們觀察了RAAF對F/A-18F Super Hornet機隊的維護流程，並認為此次演習提供了敏捷作戰部署與力量姿態的寶貴經驗。
同時，印度空軍的Rafale戰機在同一演習中首次亮相。根據AeroTime於8月7日的報導，Rafale在第26屆Pitch Black中參與高強度、低能見度訓練，測試其多用途戰鬥能力。
印度空軍第101中隊指揮官Group Captain Arun Kumar強調，此次部署彰显印度空軍進行遠距任務及在嚴苛多國環境中有效作戰的成長能力，並指出在演習中建立的夥伴關係對維護印太地區穩定具重要意義。

en.title: Finland and Sweden Debut at Pitch Black Exercise as Indian Rafale Makes Historic Appearance
en.summary: Finland and Sweden sent official delegations to Exercise Pitch Black 26 for the first time, marking their initial participation in Australia’s flagship multinational air combat exercise. The delegations visited RAAF Base Darwin to observe the training, which ran from July 20 to August 7, 2026. Meanwhile, the Indian Air Force’s Rafale fighter jet made its historic debut at the same exercise, taking part in high‑tempo, low‑visibility scenarios to test the aircraft’s capabilities alongside international partners and to strengthen defence cooperation in the Indo‑Pacific region.
body: According to an AeroTime article published on August 6, 2026, Finland and Sweden dispatched official delegations to Exercise Pitch Black 26 for the first time, observing the exercise at RAAF Base Darwin. This marked the inaugural participation of the two Nordic nations in Australia’s premier multinational air combat exercise, which ran from July 20 to August 7 across northern Australia.

The Finnish delegation, led by Lieutenant Colonel Ville Uggeldahl of the Finnish Air Warfare Centre, focused on fighter capability integration, specifically how Australia coordinates fourth- and fifth-generation fighter aircraft within a large-scale multinational setting and integrates command and control systems, fast jet platforms, and coalition partners.

The Swedish delegation, represented by Master Sergeant Ronny Hagman, an aircraft technician with the Swedish Air Force, concentrated on observing how the RAAF maintains its fleet of F/A-18F Super Hornets under the operational tempo of a major exercise, gaining insight into agile combat deployment and force posture.

In parallel, the Indian Air Force’s Rafale fighter jet made its debut appearance at Exercise Pitch Black 26, as reported by AeroTime on August 7, 2026. The Rafale participated in high-tempo, low-visibility training scenarios, providing a rare opportunity to test the aircraft’s capabilities alongside a wide range of international partners.

Group Captain Arun Kumar, Commanding Officer of 101 Squadron and Exercise Director for the IAF at Pitch Black, noted that the deployment reflected the IAF’s growing ability to conduct long-range missions and operate effectively within a demanding multinational environment, and emphasized that the relationships built during the exercise are as valuable as the missions flown.
